name: WA TAFE $420 annual fee cap for young school leavers
summary: Young people who have left school early pay no more than $420 a year in WA TAFE course fees in 2026.
key: For 2026, there is a cap of $420 per calendar year for students born on or after 1 July 2008.
who: Born on or after 1 July 2008, at least 15, not enrolled at secondary school and not in a VETDSS program
how: Provide proof of age and proof you have left school when you enrol.
catches: The cap does not apply to Recognition of Prior Learning, resource fees or commercial courses.
